summary: A disagreement can become much harder to solve once somebody decides that giving an inch means losing control.
body: A disagreement can become much harder to solve once somebody decides that giving an inch means losing control. When the Sun squares Pluto, pride and power collide, making leverage, secrecy, money, access, or authority part of a conflict that may have started over something much smaller. The harder one side pushes, the more the other may tighten its grip. Do not let the fight over control swallow the original issue. Find the thing that actually needs to change and keep your attention there.
